question: The aquatic plant ______ which is one of the most invasive weeds found growing wherever there is standing water. It drains oxygen from the water, which leads to death of fishes.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Water hyacinth.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• **Pontederia crassipes (formerly Eichhornia crassipes)**, popularly referred to as **water hyacinth **or the "**Terror of Bengal**," is an aquatic plant.
 
• This is because it **reduces **the amount of **sunshine **and dissolved **oxygen available **to **fish **and other **aquatic animals**, which stunts their ability to grow.
 
• A **free-floating aquatic **or **hydrophytic plant**, water hyacinth is indigenous to **tropical** and **subtropical **South America.
 
• Bengal received water hyacinth from India in 1884 because to its **lovely** **blossoms **and **interesting leaf shapes**, but it soon became an **invasive weed **that **drained oxygen **from the water bodies and **decimated **the **fish population**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Floating heart:**

 
 
• Common names for **Nymphoides peltata **include **Yellow Floating Heart**, **Fringed Water Lily**, and **Whole Marshwort**.
 
• This notorious perennial, also known as the "**aggressive weed**," is a member of the **aquatic **and **marsh plant genus Menyathaceae**, sometimes known as the "**buckbean family**."
 
 
 
• **Common duckweed:**
 
 
• ​Common duckweed, also known as **lesser duckweed**, or **Lemna** **minor**, is a species of **freshwater aquatic plant **that belongs to the **arum **family **Araceae's **subfamily **Lemnoideae**.
 
• L. minor has a variety of uses, including as **animal feed**, a **bioremediator**, a way to recover nutrients from wastewater, and more.
 
 
 
• **Coontail**:
 
 
• **Coontail **is a submerged aquatic species, which means it develops **below **the **water's surface**.
 
• It is a** free-floating, perennial, rootless aquatic plant **that can cover significant amounts of water in **dense colonies.​**
